updates.title: The Blessing / La Bendición

sections.label: Verse 1
linesEn: The Lord bless you
And keep you
Make His face shine upon you
And be gracious to you
The Lord turn His face towards you
And give you peace

sections.label: Chorus
linesEn: Amen

sections.label: Bridge 1
linesEn: May His favor be upon you
And a thousand generations
And your family
And your children
And their children
And their children
linesEs: Que te cubra con Su gracia

sections.label: Bridge 2
linesEn: May His presence go before you
And behind you, and beside you
All around you
And within you
He is with you
He is with you

sections.label: Bridge 3
linesEn: In the morning, in the evening
In your coming, and your going
In your weeping
And rejoicing
He is for you
He is for you

updates.filled: Moved English out of the Spanish box; filled official English and official Spanish; split the appended “Y aquí estoy yo confiando en Dios”

updates.title: Great I Am

sections.label: Verse 1
linesEn: I want to be close, close to Your side
So Heaven is real and death is a lie
I want to hear voices, of angels above
Singing as one

sections.label: Chorus
linesEn: Hallelujah, holy holy
God Almighty, the Great I AM
Who is worthy? None beside Thee
God Almighty, the Great I AM

sections.label: Verse 2
linesEn: I want to be near, near to Your heart
Loving the world, hating the dark
I want to see dry bones living again
Singing as one

sections.label: Bridge
linesEn: The mountains shake before Him
The demons run and flee
At the mention of the name, King of Majesty
There is no power in hell
Or any who can stand
Before the power and the presence of the Great I AM
linesEs: Ante el poder y la presencia del Gran Yo Soy

updates.filled: Completed truncated title; cleaned singer cues from English; replaced messy/truncated Spanish with official En Espíritu y En Verdad / Integrity Spanish
updates.notes: CCLI 5881491, Jared Anderson. Existing English body retained (cues removed).

updates.title: What a Beautiful Name

sections.label: Verse 1
linesEn: You were the Word at the beginning
One with God the Lord Most High
Your hidden glory in creation
Now revealed in You our Christ
linesEs: Tú fuiste el verbo en el principio

sections.label: Chorus 1
linesEn: What a beautiful Name it is
What a beautiful Name it is
The Name of Jesus Christ my King
What a beautiful Name it is
Nothing compares to this
What a beautiful Name it is
The Name of Jesus
linesEs: El nombre de Jesús mi Rey

sections.label: Verse 2
linesEn: You didn't want heaven without us
So Jesus, You brought heaven down
My sin was great, Your love was greater
What could separate us now?

sections.label: Chorus 2
linesEn: What a wonderful Name it is
What a wonderful Name it is
The Name of Jesus Christ my King
What a wonderful Name it is
Nothing compares to this
What a wonderful Name it is
The Name of Jesus
linesEs: El nombre de Jesús mi Rey

sections.label: Bridge
linesEn: Death could not hold You
The veil tore before You
You silenced the boast of sin and grave
The heavens are roaring
The praise of Your glory
For You are raised to life again
You have no rival
You have no equal
Now and forever, God, You reign
Yours is the Kingdom
Yours is the glory
Yours is the Name above all names

sections.label: Chorus 3
linesEn: What a powerful Name it is
What a powerful Name it is
The Name of Jesus Christ my King
What a powerful Name it is
Nothing can stand against
What a powerful Name it is
The Name of Jesus
linesEs: El nombre de Jesús mi Rey
